name: Lifts an object to the mouth
text: She lifts the cup from the table to her mouth.
desc: Business - the small practical action that makes a held shot feel inhabited rather than paused.
needs: a person and a cup on a surface in frame
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04, 3 seeds, watched at subject crop. THE CLEAREST PROOF IN THE LIBRARY THAT THE METRIC IS BLIND. Motion 0.814/0.798/0.816 - barely above the empty control - while the strips show a full four-stage action on all three seeds: she looks down, reaches, closes her hand on the cup, lifts it and drinks. Face held and framing intact 3/3. Ranked by the number this would have been discarded; it is one of the best cards here. Band 0.406-0.744 (empty control 0.628); frame-scale ceiling 1.191.
